title: Body mass index and dyslipidemia influence responses to anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in colorectal cancer.
snippet: Obesity is one of the primary risk factors for colorectal cancer (CRC) development, but  the impact of obesity on therapeutic responses to anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) immunotherapy in CRC remains unclear. title: Phage anti-defense genes targeting NADmetabolism and DNA replication are associated with a broad host range against.
snippet: Phage therapy for drug-resistant() is limited by narrow host ranges. We isolated a broad-host-range phage, vB_KP_P4, that lyses 109 diversestrains, including multidrug-resistant (MDR) and carbapenem-resistant isolates. title: Identification of a candidate PRODH allosteric inhibitor MBTP-15324: modulation of proline metabolite profiles and ECM-associated gene-expression changes in lung cancer cells.
publicationName: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry

snippet: Current proline dehydrogenase (PRODH) inhibitors lack scaffold diversity.
